verdict.rationale: The pack documents a comprehensive Admin API, an llms.txt file and an MCP server, but none of these is a downloadable machine-readable API spec. No item mentions an OpenAPI or equivalent spec file. The Admin API, llms.txt and MCP server are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
